data.title: Fine notice for tailgating on the A 1 (€128.50)
data.summary: The district administration's fine office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for keeping too little distance on the A 1 on 19 March 2025. The total to pay is €128.50, with 1 point in the driver fitness register. The notice was formally delivered on 17 April 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving too close to the vehicle ahead at 112 km/h. The fine is €100, plus €25 fees and €3.50 delivery costs, and it carries 1 point. If you dispute the accusation or the consequences, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fine office; the app shows the deadline, which runs from the delivery date. A court may decide differently, including to your disadvantage. If you do not object, the notice becomes final and the total is due two weeks after that. Consider legal advice if unsure.
